## What changed

**scripts/verify_carryover_inputs.py** (+66 lines):

1. Added `_HF_CITED_RE` regex (after `_BARE_NAME_RE`, L109-129) matching bare basenames cited under an HF data-repo prefix — two families:
    - short prefix `issue<N>_<slug>/…/<name>.<ext>`
    - full prefix `explore-persona-space-data/issue<N>_<slug>/…/<name>.<ext>`
    Uses anchored `/segment` groups + a mandatory pre-name `/` so the greedy path-chars alternative cannot backtrack into the middle of a basename (adversarial-planner review Q1 fix; the earlier `[\w./\-]*` form was silently truncating `pool.jsonl` to `l.jsonl`).
2. Added `extract_hf_cited_basenames(text: str) -> set[str]` (after `extract_bare_names`, L168-176) — thin helper that returns the SET of HF-cited basenames for paired-hit lookup.
3. Refactored `run_check()` Channel-B inner loop (L580-L692) to collect per-name findings into a `pending` list, then post-classify downgrade `untracked-local-only` FAILs to WARN in two narrow cases:
    - `hf-staged` — name in the plan's HF-cited set (`name in hf_cited`)
    - `duplicate-resolution` — a sibling resolution in `pending` has `verdict=pass reason=in-ref`
    Then `findings.extend(pending)`. The classify() call and every skip branch stay byte-identical to the pre-refactor code path.

**tests/test_verify_carryover_inputs.py** (+121 lines): 5 new tests
1. `test_bare_name_hf_staged_short_prefix_warns_not_fails` — #1979 short HF form
2. `test_bare_name_hf_staged_full_repo_prefix_warns_not_fails` — full HF repo prefix
3. `test_bare_name_multi_resolution_downgrade` — #1739 in-ref-sibling shape
4. `test_bare_name_untracked_still_fails_when_no_hf_citation_and_single_resolution` — #1434 protection regression pin
5. `test_issue_underscore_git_path_not_matched_by_hf_regex` — regex-boundary regression pin (adversarial-planner review Q1)

The #1434 protection stays: a truly untracked-local-only citation with NEITHER an HF citation NOR an in-ref sibling STAYS a fail-loud.
